name: @lacspace/explainer
description: Turn an article into an explainer without an LLM — English or Nepali: title / what happened / why it matters / key numbers (shown exactly as written) / who's involved / background / what's next / CTA slides, a ready @lacspace/newscard carousel, a 30–60 s video script with scenes (voiceover ≤30 words, on-screen line, duration from word count, English stock-footage queries, overlay hints for stingers/lower-thirds/stat), FAQ pairs, category detection and hashtags. Built on TextRank (@lacspace/extractive) + keyphrase. Optional LLM polish of voiceover lines with a facts lock that rejects invented digits.
author: Lacspace <contact@lacspace.com>
